summary: Albany County lookout tower near Fletcher Park: wooden tower replaced by steel in 1953-54, one staffer listed for 1950, now listed as gone; no site description found.

facts.design: steel cab that replaced an earlier wooden structure
facts.status_note: Listed as gone; one lookout history page says removed. No removal date is given.

events.note: Orin Beckwith listed as lookout personnel for 1950.
Forest Service announced in May 1953 that the wooden tower was being replaced by steel; the lookout listing gives 1953 for the steel cab.
February 1954 report says the La Prele district had erected a new steel tower at Fletcher Park.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The lookout listing dates the steel cab to 1953, while the February 14, 1954 newspaper report describes the tower as newly erected. The story reports both: replacement was announced in May 1953 and the new tower was described as erected in February 1954.
The May 1953 report calls the site Fletcher Peak; the February 1954 report and both lookout pages use Fletcher Park.

notes_for_editor: The steel tower date is in conflict between the directory (1953) and the newspaper report (erected by February 1954); the story gives both. The newspaper items are second-hand quotes on the westlookouts page and were not checked against the originals. No source gives the wooden tower's build date, the tower height, or what remains at the site today.
